blocks.prompt: 3 (a) In how many different ways can the following persons sit in a round table? Hint (Solve according to both the cases): 8 persons
blocks.explanation:
8 log gol (round) table par bethne hain, yani yeh circular permutation ka sawal hai.
Hint kehta hai dono cases hal karne hain: Case-I aur Case-II.
Plan: ek shakhs ko fix karein, baaqi ko arrange karein; Case-II mein jawab ko 2 se divide karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 8\) log, round table.
Humein find karna hai: Case-I aur Case-II dono mein bethne ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Case-I (clockwise aur anticlockwise tarteeb alag maani jaye): \((n - 1)!\). Case-II (clockwise aur anticlockwise tarteeb ek hi maani jaye): \(\dfrac{(n - 1)!}{2}\). Round table par sirf \((n - 1)!\) is liye ke sab log ek ek seat ghoom jayen to bethne ki tarteeb wahi rehti hai; is liye ek shakhs ko fix kar dete hain aur baaqi ko arrange karte hain.

Case-I
\[(8 - 1)! = 7! = 5040\]
Kyun: Seedhi line mein pehli aur aakhri seat alag hoti hai, lekin gol table par koi 'pehli' seat nahi. Agar sab log ek seat aage khisak jayen to har shakhs ke daayen baayen wahi log rehte hain, yani tarteeb wahi hai. Is liye ek shakhs ko kisi seat par fix kar dete hain; baaqi 7 log 7! tareeqon se beth sakte hain.
Dhyan dein: Gol table par \(8!\) likhna sab se aam ghalti hai; \(8!\) seedhi line ke liye hai.

Case-II
\[\dfrac{(8 - 1)!}{2} = \dfrac{5040}{2} = 2520\]
Kyun: Case-II mein clockwise tarteeb aur us ki ulti (anticlockwise) tarteeb ko ek hi maana jata hai, jaise haar (necklace) ko palat dein to wahi haar rehta hai. Case-I mein har aisi jori do dafa gini gayi thi, is liye 2 se divide kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[8! \div 8 = 5040 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Seedhi line mein 8! tareeqe hain. Har gol tarteeb line mein 8 dafa aati hai (har shakhs se shuru kar ke), is liye 8 se divide karne par Case-I ka jawab milna chahiye, aur mila.
